headline: 1,400 Trillion Won in State Property Becomes 'National Assets'…Ending Gaps in Virtual Asset Management and Real Estate Silos
summary: The government will restructure state property exceeding 1,400 trillion won from ownership and preservation targets into national assets aimed at creating value. The plan aims to address gaps in virtual asset management and real estate silos.
why: State property management affects public finances and the value of government-owned real estate and assets.
